meta.title: GOIA Lounge — Shisha lounge in Kehl, next to Strasbourg
meta.description: GOIA, an elegant huqqa lounge in Kehl, just across from Strasbourg: signature shishas, mocktails, desserts and DJ nights. Book your table online.

hero.tagline: Exceptional shishas, mocktails and softly lit nights, just across from Strasbourg.

quick.title: Book your table

experience.title: A lounge made for taking your time
experience.intro: Amber light, marble, velvet and soft smoke: at GOIA, every detail invites you to slow down.
experience.ambiance: An intimate setting, dimmed lights and spaces for two or for the whole group.
experience.shisha: Premium bowls, selected tobaccos and house creations, carefully prepared by our shisha masters.
experience.service: An attentive team, regular coal changes and desserts made for sharing.
experience.music: Deep house and oriental sounds, with DJ nights at the weekend.

menuPreview.text: From house creations to reimagined classics, and freshly made mocktails.
